title: One month building Hiraeth: a Moebius-inspired adventure game, with Opus 5.5, Astra, Tripo & Suno
author: 4nf
selftext:
Hiraeth (Welsh word for longing or homesickness) is meant to be a Zelda style game where you go from planet to planet, explore the world, go into temples etc. I wanted it to feel a Moebius set of worlds. Here’s the teaser from a month of working on it.

I used Opus 5.5 and Astra for development, Midjourney for visual references, Tripo for 3D assets (some of them, a lot of them are being generated directly in engine by Opus and Astra), and Suno for music. The game runs on Three.js (but I also have Unity builds that use a JS bridge to avoid rewriting it all in C#). A few things I did process-wise: 

* **Design audits:** I tried to turn gaming design principles into reusable agent skills, then regularly audit the game against them. Across all 14 temples, does each one teach a mechanic, test it, then give it a twist?
* **Serendipity map:** I built a map that highlights walkable ground more than 50 meters from anything to discover. 
* [**Visual changelog**](https://hiraeth.my/changelog): Every visual change gets a screenshot from the running game. Comparing the same room from the same angle tells me a lot more than a note saying “improved lighting.”
* **3D assets:** I go back and forth between Tripo, Meshy, and models built directly in Three.js. For one enemy, I tried different rigs on the same body and watched it swing in the arena. 

[**Play it here**](https://hiraeth.my)  
  
It's much better with a controller, there are also android builds that work on stuff like retroid pocket, Odin 3 etc.. which is where I've been playing the game. I'd love some feedback, harsh one especially to see if I want to keep spending time on it.

replies.author: 4nf

I gave it 200 Midjourney references and I asked it to replicate it as close as it could:

[https://hiraeth.my/?level=references](https://hiraeth.my/?level=references) If you press "\\" here you should see the jpg reference that it tried to replicate.

That was very very useful to get the line work to be good.

EDIT: also you should be able to point your agent at [hiraeth.my](http://hiraeth.my) and ask to pull the shaders since it's all web based.

replies.author: 4nf
replies.body:
I asked the agent: "research best practices on X", X being "combat, world design, temple design, story, etc.."

Then I asked it to bake the research into a skill. then run the audit skill on the game, then fix the audit issues until the game reaches a score of X on the skill benchmark.
